description: This file defines a MultiSelector class that manages multiple file input elements, allowing users to select multiple files, dynamically add new file inputs, and remove selected files from the list. It is used for handling multi-file uploads in a web interface.

classes.name: MultiSelector
classes.description: A class to convert a single file input element into a multiple file input list, allowing dynamic addition and removal of file inputs.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new file input element, sets up onchange handler to add new inputs and update the list.

methods.name: addListRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to the list displaying the selected file with a delete button.
